entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF77819.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see the Aero Pro cycling shoes. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work. I want a refund.
I understand. To make sure I'm getting you to the right place, is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or more of a sizing or preference issue?
They give me blisters. Horrible ones. So I guess that's a preference issue, if you want to call it that.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how frustrating that can be. Sometimes, adjusting the position of the cleats can relieve pressure points. Did you have a chance to try repositioning them at all?
Whatever. I'm done with them. I just want my money back.
Of course. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery date was 74 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on these items for up to 90 days.

So you are absolutely eligible. I can go ahead and start that return process for you. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. As soon as we receive the cycling shoes, we will process your full refund to the original payment method.
Fine. I'll look for the email.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
